_doc: Scene library for agents/ad-batch. Seeded 2026-10-06 from Everitt Moder's Trybe sets and the three spike batches. family spreads a batch across looks; typeStyle steers the headline lettering (a plain prompt gets plain catalogue type); suits limits a scene to product categories (all, skin, bath, oral, deodorant, lip); hands marks scenes that show hands; inUse means the product is being used, so a bar soap shows the bare bar. Add scenes freely. Ids must be unique and stable, because rotation history keys on them.
